title: Chain of custody
purpose: Review one order’s client, project, turnaround, purchase order, shipment details, delivery commitment and received samples; continue receipt, edit its details or record the reason an expected shipment will not arrive.
summary: One chain of custody: its client, project, turnaround, shipment details, delivery target and every sample received on it. Continue receipt from here.

tasks.title: Receive the samples
steps: Select [[Receive first sample]] or [[Receive next sample]] for each physical sample in the shipment.

tasks.title: Print labels
steps: Select [[Labels]], choose Each container or Each sample, and set [[Copies of each]].
Select [[Download PDF]] and print at actual size.

tasks.title: Fix the details
steps: Select [[Edit details]] for the turnaround, purchase order, shipment or instructions.
Use [[Change delivery target]] or [[Correct reference]] in the More menu for those two. Each asks for a reason.

tasks.title: Record a shipment that will not arrive
steps: Select [[Cancel chain of custody]] and give the [[Reason]]. This works only while no sample has been received.

good_to_know: The delivery target is the date agreed with the client. It is not a holding-time deadline.
Purchase order missing is a reminder only. It does not block receipt.
Once a sample is on an issued report, the reference can no longer be corrected.
A chain of custody opened from a client submission is cancelled or reinstated on that submission.
Printing labels changes nothing on the sample or its custody.

items.label: Reference / Client / Project
items.description: The order reference and project/client that all received samples share. The client name opens the client record.

items.label: Rush
items.description: A Rush marker appears in the header when the order’s turnaround is Rush.

items.label: Delivery target
items.description: Agreed local date/time or not set; distinct from holding-time deadlines. Once the target has passed it carries a red “Overdue N d” pill (just “Overdue” on the day itself); within the seven days before it, an amber “Due in N d” or “Due today” pill. Otherwise the date stands alone. A cancelled chain of custody shows no pill.

items.label: Created / by
items.description: When and by whom the order was created.

items.label: From client submission
items.description: When present, shows the planned-work submission. Custodians/project managers/administrators can open it; other staff see its number.

items.label: Purchase order missing
items.description: A warning shown while the order is not cancelled, has no purchase order and the client is marked Purchase order required. Staff who can receive are told to add it with Edit details. It is a reminder and does not block receipt.

items.label: Samples received
items.description: How many samples have been received against this chain of custody so far.

sections.title: Order details
paragraphs: A card on the order with the shipment and billing details that were entered on the order or carried over from an accepted client submission.

items.label: Turnaround
items.description: Standard or Rush, with the project’s standard turnaround in days beside it.

items.label: Purchase order
items.description: The order’s purchase order, or a dash.

items.label: Project number / Program
items.description: From the project: its project number and its regulatory program with the permit or program ID. Dashes when unrecorded.

items.label: Delivery
items.description: The delivery method (Client drop-off, Laboratory courier / pickup, Commercial carrier, Mail or Other) with any carrier or tracking number beneath it; a dash when not recorded.

items.label: Coolers / packages
items.description: Declared number in the shipment, or a dash.

items.label: Special instructions
items.description: Instructions entered for this chain of custody, or a dash.

items.label: Project standing instructions
items.description: Shown only when the project has standing instructions.

items.label: Receive first sample / Receive next sample
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators open receipt under this order. Shown only while the order is not cancelled; the active client/project checks also apply at receipt.

items.label: Edit details
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators open the reasoned edit form for turnaround, purchase order, delivery method, carrier/tracking, coolers/packages and special instructions. Shown only while the order is not cancelled.

items.label: Change delivery target
items.description: Opens the reasoned rescheduling form while not cancelled. In the header’s More menu.

items.label: Correct reference
items.description: Opens a reasoned correction for all samples under this order. An issued report containing a sample blocks reference correction. In the header’s More menu.

items.label: Cancel chain of custody
items.description: Available to receipt roles only when no samples have been received, the order is active and it was not opened by a client submission. Enter required Reason. Cancellation preserves the order and reason; it blocks further receipt and target changes. If samples exist, use their disposition workflow instead.

items.label: Reinstate chain of custody
items.description: Available for a cancelled order not owned by a client submission. Required Reason records reinstatement; client and project must be active. Submission-owned orders must be cancelled/reinstated from the linked submission page.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required in cancellation/reinstatement forms. Both actions recheck the order revision; a stale or ineligible action returns an error message here without changing the order.

sections.title: Samples on this chain of custody
paragraphs: The empty state invites receipt of the first sample; a cancelled banner records actor, time and reason instead.

items.label: Lab ID
items.description: Opens the sample record. Rows are ordered by laboratory ID; this table is not paginated.

items.label: Client sample ID / Type
items.description: Client identifier and sample type (Field sample, Field duplicate, Field blank, Trip blank or Equipment / rinsate blank).

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Recorded matrix, with the sample source beneath it when one is recorded.

items.label: Collected / Received
items.description: Collection or composite-end time and actual receipt time, displayed in laboratory local time.

items.label: Containers
items.description: Count of received containers for the sample.

items.label: Disposition / Location
items.description: Current sample decision and custody location.

items.label: Labels
items.description: Opens options for identity labels; printing does not change receipt, custody, preservation or sample state.

items.label: Print labels for
items.description: Each container is selected initially; Each sample prints one sample identity instead. Container labels carry their stable container barcode, visible container label, client sample ID, laboratory ID, matrix and collection time; sample labels carry the sample barcode/ID, client ID, matrix and collection time.

items.label: Copies of each
items.description: Whole number from 1 to 10, initially 1. The combined download cannot exceed 200 labels; use an individual sample when an order is too large.

items.label: Download PDF
items.description: Opens a PDF in a new tab, one 4 × 2 inch label per page. Print at actual size. Only received samples/containers are printable; empty or invalid requests are refused. Reprint after correcting values shown on a label.

items.label: Reference corrected
items.description: Chronological history of reference corrections, showing actor, time, reason and old/new reference. Earlier references remain recorded.

items.label: Details updated
items.description: Chronological list, shown only after a first change, of each Edit details save with its actor, time and reason. The previous and new values are kept in the audit record, not listed here.
